levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد

notes: «جميعا» joins the two co-transmitters in one level; the two Imams after «عن» are narrators (owner ruling 2) and speak together («قالا»)
«رضي الله عنه» and the blessing letters «ع» and «ص» are left out; «خالد بن سنان» inside the saying is content, not a link
